title: Check one evidence file
responsibility: Read one declared evidence file, verify its stored identity and content, and release memoized source bytes afterward.

inputs.name: hubEvidenceFile.base
inputs.description: A pinned source context supplies the repository, commit, tree entries, and source adapter used to locate and read the file. Its adapter may release cached bytes for the joined path after the check finishes.

inputs.name: hubEvidenceFile.input
inputs.description: Contains an evidence pointer (commit, path, and manifest SHA-256) and a file declaration (path, SHA-256, byte count, storage, and optional media type). The function joins the paths and checks one file against its declaration.

outputs.name: evidenceFileLimit
outputs.description: The maximum accepted file size is 50,000,000 bytes, for both Git LFS objects and ordinary stored files. The function rejects declared, stored, or raw file content above this ceiling.

outputs.name: hubEvidenceFile
outputs.description: Returns a problem when the file is missing or its stored LFS pointer does not match the declaration. Otherwise returns the bytes and problems, with a frozen fact containing the Git blob SHA only when the bytes match the declared size and SHA-256.

problems: doorbell.mp4 is missing from the evidence branch

errors.name: evidence-file-too-large
errors.description: Thrown when the declared file size, Git tree entry size, or raw file size exceeds the 50,000,000-byte limit.

errors.name: cache-hash-mismatch
errors.description: Thrown when materialized Git LFS bytes differ in size or SHA-256 from the declared file after the stored LFS pointer matches it.

errors.name: artifact-corrupt
errors.description: Thrown when the raw Git blob SHA-1 does not match the blob ID in its tree entry.
